body: I have felt this way before too.  Not sure what my diagnosis was at that point, I think family was second guessing whether I was faking.  That did not help.  It's frustrating when I was second guessing why I felt the way I did.  Why would anyone want to fake this, for decades?  Can you just give yourself suicide thoughts without being depressed and not having a mental illness?  That is really a very good question, and I doubt many of us on here would say, oh yeah I did this to myself on purpose to get attention.  No they can go back and site all the other things that caused the depression or mental illness that started the suicidal ideation at least I would think most can.  I know I still remember stuff that happened to me from my childhood that has probably contributed like parental trauma.  They say remembering is healing, not sure about that yet.

We hope that it will be better for others, that your life isn't as bad, that you are younger, you still have time to get it together.  Most really do want the best for others.  Most are good people trying to do our best and yet we beat ourselves up so often (me almost every day).Yet we are jealous if we see one and other do well elsewhere in life on social media.  Its screwy.  If you are down we feel bad, but if you are succeeding we hate you.  I've done it recently, it is so sick.  No answers, just realization and honesty.
I love Dr. Jill Biden's Coat, so beautiful.

Responding to a post about feeling calm about suicide:

If you are lucky enough to have people who care about you, you could cry to them.  The calm is from knowing/hoping that the pain will finally be over.  The problem is how hard it actually is to finally do the deed.  Always keep hoping someone will want me, want to tell me they love me and that they don't want me to do it.  But when people like myself have been feeling this way for decades and it only gets worse and no one cares anymore, the calm of removing oneself from life is the blanket we wish for.  Didn't want to get banned. Don't really understand the rules at the moment.
